name: Cinematic Spatial UX Program

sourceSignals.usefulIdea: Quality, motion, animation, sequence, and fallback controls should be treated as product settings before any heavy 3D implementation.
Atmosphere tokens and local performance budgets keep cinematic UI calm, readable, and thermally safe.
A dedicated route or section should isolate experimental depth before it is promoted into the main product surface.

qualityPresets.label: Low-power
qualityPresets.target: mobile, battery-sensitive laptops, reduced data sessions

productLanes.title: UX Audit Room
productLanes.summary: A calm review space for interface hierarchy, accessibility, and content clarity.

productLanes.title: Journey Map Studio
productLanes.summary: A spatial map for user flows, decision points, friction, and service moments.

productLanes.title: Cinematic Motion Planner
productLanes.summary: A reduced-motion-aware planning surface for transitions, sequence, pacing, and emphasis.

rules: No 3D dependency without a budget note.
Every motion feature must have a reduced-motion equivalent.
Cinematic depth must clarify product structure, not distract from it.
The native Node/static app remains the rollback-safe baseline.
